items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I went to see Roy Martin, the section hand foreman, and told him I wanted a job

ctx.x: Anyway, I started school in Tuskegee, but before that, I was trying to figure out how was I going to go to school. There was a fellow with the railroad that had a section

gang and I heard, as a youngster, that he wanted to hire some extra people, and there were still a lot of the oldtimers calling me Sonny Boy, and I went to see Roy Martin, the section hand foreman, and told him I wanted a job, that school was out and he said, what can you do, Sonny Boy? I said I--
